subject: iALS kickoff - an honest recommendation baseline for the platform
body:
Team,

Kicking off the iALS baseline track. Context: our open-source work ('Revisiting the Performance of iALS on Item Recommendation Benchmarks' and 'iALS++: Speeding up Matrix Factorization with Subspace Optimization') showed that a well-tuned implicit ALS is embarrassingly competitive with neural recommenders at a fraction of the cost. For data-platforms, the goal is a trustworthy internal baseline: any team proposing a fancy recommender should have to beat tuned iALS first.

Scope: reproduce the NCF-protocol results on MovieLens 1M and Pinterest, package the tuning recipe (holdout generation included), and hand Evalline a runnable baseline config. Milestones: environment and data by mid-Feb, repro by late March, packaged baseline + write-up by 2026-04-27.

Bilal leads repro, Linnea tuning methodology, Rosa packaging, Oyin infra. Deshawn - resourcing note please. This one is cheap on compute and heavy on rigor.

Dmitri
